decks.notes: This deck focuses on generating a wide board presence of creatures with Winota, Joiner of Forces as the centerpiece. By playing low-cost creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to quickly ramp into larger threats like Voice of Resurgence and Tovolar's Huntmaster. Using Winota's ability to cheat out multiple creatures from the library, the deck can overwhelm opponents with powerful attacks. Cards like Brutal Cathar and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional utility and removal options to clear the way for a decisive victory.

The deck revolves around quickly casting spells to fill the graveyard with cards like Arclight Phoenix and bringing it back to the battlefield for repeated damage. The deck also utilizes cheap removal spells and counterspells to control the board and protect its threats. Key cards like Thing in the Ice and Temporal Trespass provide additional threats and ways to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized for casting spells efficiently and consistently throughout the game.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by using cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and control the board with cards like Supreme Verdict and Shark Typhoon. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and board presence. The deck also includes lands that provide various utility options to further enhance control over the game.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board through counterspells and removal while generating card advantage through draw spells like Memory Deluge. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the game and outvalue opponents. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and synergy with cards like Omen of the Sea and Shark Typhoon. The deck aims to survive the early game and transition into a dominant late-game position with powerful threats and disruption.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard and then bring it back to the battlefield while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thing in the Ice and Spell Pierce. The deck is built around generating tempo and card advantage through cards like Galvanic Iteration and Treasure Cruise, while also leveraging cantrips like Opt and Expressive Iteration to smooth out draws and find key pieces. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while also providing access to a diverse range of colors for spells like Lightning Axe and Pieces of the Puzzle.

The key strategy of this deck revolves around controlling the game through powerful instant and sorcery spells, card draw, and utility planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils. By combining removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage engines like Treasure Cruise and Day's Undoing, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' plans and maintain card advantage. Additionally, threats like Niv-Mizzet, Parun and Thing in the Ice provide win conditions, while lands like Otawara, Soaring City and Hall of Storm Giants offer additional value and flexibility. The deck's versatility and synergy allow for adaptable gameplay and strategic decision-making.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo using cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, along with support from cards like Voldaren Epicure and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Axe to control the board while setting up the combo. With a mix of graveyard recursion and aggressive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful synergy that can finish the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while using Winota, Joiner of Forces to cheat out powerful creatures like Blade Historian and Tovolar's Huntmaster. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a rapid board presence and synergistic combos, supported by cards like Brutal Cathar and Prosperous Innkeeper. By maximizing the potential of Winota's ability to put creatures onto the battlefield, this deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent in the early and mid-game to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells in order to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. By playing efficient threats like Gifted Aetherborn and Gray Merchant of Asphodel, combined with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Bloodchief's Thirst, the deck aims to control the game while steadily draining the opponent's life total. Additionally, cards like The Meathook Massacre and Underworld Dreams provide additional ways to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. Overall, the deck looks to maintain board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to maximize mana production through a combination of mana dorks and enchantments, allowing for powerful green devotion cards to be played quickly and efficiently. By ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck can drop big threats like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional utility and card advantage to overwhelm opponents with a strong aggro strategy centered around green devotion.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up green devotion by playing mana dorks and powerful green creatures, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Storm the Festival. The deck also takes advantage of green planeswalkers like Nissa and Kiora to generate additional value and create threats. Karn, the Great Creator serves as utility and disruption while Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx provides additional mana for big plays. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creature base and powerful green spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays and burning the opponent down quickly with a mix of creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to maintain early pressure with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bonecrusher Giant, while using burn spells like Play with Fire and Skewer the Critics to finish off the opponent. Chandra, Dressed to Kill provides additional burn and card advantage, while Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins offer late-game reach. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize, utilizing its efficient and low-cost cards to close out the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on controlling the game with counterspells and removal spells, while also generating value with cards like Narset, Teferi, and Yorion. It aims to outvalue the opponent by drawing cards, countering key spells, and eventually overwhelming them with powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and Supreme Verdict. The mana base is designed to support the control game plan, providing the necessary colors and utility lands to help stabilize the board and ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, this deck excels at maintaining control of the game and grinding out wins through incremental advantage.

The main concept of this Winota combo deck is to quickly ramp up mana with Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while using cards like Brutal Cathar and Tovolar's Huntmaster to put pressure on the opponent. Winota, Joiner of Forces serves as the key card to trigger powerful abilities and generate value by putting non-human creatures onto the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Elite Spellbinder and Voice of Resurgence for disruption and protection, along with Eldritch Evolution for additional toolbox options. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes multiple pathways and dual lands for flexibility.

The deck focuses on utilizing Winota, Joiner of Forces to trigger powerful creature cards like Brutal Cathar and Tovolar's Huntmaster from the library, overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of attacking creatures. The deck also includes ramping creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to accelerate the board presence, with support from cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Esika's Chariot to provide additional value and protection. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently assembling a board state of diverse creatures through Winota's ability to generate sweet, sweet card advantage and field pressure.

This Winota deck aims to ramp up quickly with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, while generating tokens with cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Voice of Resurgence. The key strategy is to get Winota, Joiner of Forces on the battlefield to trigger her ability and cheat out powerful creatures like Brutal Cathar and Tovolar's Huntmaster. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Esika's Chariot to maximize Winota's triggers and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures.
